<goal_round>
Objective: "抓取海外网站信息，挖掘可执行的赚钱路子。1) 已完成：3 篇笔记 + V2EX 50 案例 + 赏金机制 + 情报脚本，均已 commit push；2) 本轮重点：抓海外独立开发者/副业社区（Indie Hackers、Reddit r/sidehustle 和 r/beermoney、Hacker News、Product Hunt、Algora、Gumroad/AppSumo 榜单、Upwork/Fiverr 冷门品类）；3) 每条路子必须有：具体做什么、在哪做、怎么做、真实收入数字、启动成本、见效周期、稳定性和竞争程度；4) 优先适合软件开发者、可远程、不需大额资金；5) 排除小红书/抖音（§0.1红线）；6) 所有数字标注信源。用户已开 VPN，海外站可直接访问。"
Round: 2/256

Continue working toward the objective in this same session. Treat the current workspace, tool results, and durable session state as authoritative; inspect them instead of assuming earlier narration is still current. Make concrete progress and verify the result. Before claiming completion, gather evidence that the whole objective is achieved, read the current goal, and mark it complete. If work remains, leave the goal active for the next round. Follow the configured goal-tool policy before reporting a blocker.
</goal_round>
